name: Critical Effects (BC): Impact - Arm
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-15 (p. 252). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: The target drops anything held in that hand.
The target drops anything held in that hand. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or take [[1d10]] Weapon Skill Damage and [[1d10]] Ballistic Skill Damage.
Stunned for 1 round and drops whatever was held. 10% chance the held item is damaged and unusable until repaired.
The limb is useless until medical attention.
[[1d5]] fingers broken. 1 level of Fatigue. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or suffer 2 permanent Weapon Skill Damage and 2 permanent Ballistic Skill Damage.
Arm broken: counts as having one arm until repaired. Blood Loss.
Arm severed. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds, [[1d5]] levels of Fatigue and Blood Loss.
The target dies. Anyone within 2 metres takes [[1d5-3]] Impact Damage to a random hit location.
